warbonds.name: Helldivers Mobilize!
warbonds.notes: Free Warbond access; equipment requires Medals in game. Only mark items you have unlocked as owned. Complete reviewed rollable set: 10 primaries, 1 sidearm, 3 throwables, 6 boosters; no stratagems. Excludes starter equipment, separately purchased Superstore items and cosmetics. In-game background art retrieved via Dogo314 / Helldivers Wiki.gg; not a screenshot of the acquisition menu.
